controls.title: Outflow destination allowlist
controls.assertion: Every payment sent by the Core Vault lands on an allowlisted address or the custodian.

controls.title: Control preconditions
controls.assertion: The allowlist is populated, deduplicated, and the custodian and vault addresses are set.

controls.title: Escrow backing
controls.assertion: Every UBA Flare records as escrowed is matched by XRP sitting in an Escrow object on the XRP Ledger.
controls.observation: 50 escrow objects totalling 500000000000 drops match Flare's escrowedFunds exactly

controls.title: Liquid backing
controls.assertion: What Flare can spend today does not exceed the vault's spendable XRP after the ledger's reserve.
controls.observation: 3631123841795 drops spendable covers Flare's 3629444161854 UBA with 1679679941 to spare (reserve 11200000 over 51 owned objects)

controls.title: Available-funds wedge
controls.assertion: The difference between the raw and advertised available balances is disclosed.
controls.observation: raw availableFunds exceeds advertised immediatelyAvailable by 400 UBA (expected: the asset manager nets a fee)
